name: Train crew model
definition: Staff on board who run the train in normal service, summarized across the system's lines. two_person = driver plus conductor (TPTO) on all lines; mostly_two_person = TPTO on most lines, OPTO on some; one_person = driver only (OPTO); unattended = no operating staff on board (ZPTO, GoA4). The per-line detail goes in notes.

name: Crew model by line
definition: Free text: the crew model of each line as stated by the source.

name: Overnight service
definition: Whether trains run through the night. 24h_all_week = all or most lines run every night; 24h_weekends_some_lines = some lines run overnight on some nights only; closes_nightly = no service for a period every night.

name: Nightly closure length
definition: Typical number of hours each night with no passenger service (engineering window). Note which days.

name: Route length
definition: Length of the metro network in passenger service, counting each route section once. Note the system boundary used by the source.

name: Stations
definition: Number of stations as counted by the source. Transfer complexes may count once or several times; note which.

name: Lines
definition: Number of lines (services or routes) as counted by the source.

name: Year first line opened
definition: Year the first section of the system opened to passengers.

name: Average station spacing
definition: route_km divided by (stations minus number of lines), or as reported. Derived rows cite inputs.

name: Express tracks
definition: Whether the system runs express services on separate tracks (three or four tracks on main trunks).

name: Interlining
definition: Whether services share tracks with other services (branching and merging), which spreads delays.

name: Main signaling type
definition: Signaling used on most of the network.

name: Share of lines with CBTC
definition: Lines (or share of route-km) under communications-based train control in service, as stated by the source.

name: Grade of automation
definition: Grade of automation (GoA 1 to 4) per line as stated by the source.

name: Platform screen doors
definition: Presence of full- or half-height platform screen doors or gates.

name: Longest regular train
definition: Number of cars in the longest trains in regular service.

name: Longest regular train length
definition: Length in meters of the longest trains in regular service.

name: Unionization of operating staff
definition: Main unions representing operating staff, and notable work rules (crew rules, overtime rules, staffing mandates) as stated by the source.

name: Legal staffing mandate
definition: Any law or contract clause that fixes crew or station staffing levels.

name: Operations and maintenance contracting
definition: Whether operations and maintenance are in-house, contracted out (franchise or concession), or mixed.

name: Pension and benefit cost share
definition: Fringe benefits (pensions, health care) as a share of total labor cost or of operating cost; state which denominator.

name: Funding mix
definition: Shares of operating funding from fares, government subsidy, and other income (property, advertising, retail), as stated by the source.

name: Operating subsidy
definition: Whether the operator needs public money to cover operating costs. none = fares and other income cover operating cost.

name: Governance
definition: Who owns and who operates the system (state agency, municipal company, listed company), and who sets fares.

name: National average annual wage
definition: OECD average annual wage per full-time-equivalent dependent employee in the system's country (national accounts basis, includes bonuses), current prices. Used to compare a system's pay with its own labour market.

name: Benefit share of compensation, employer benchmark
definition: Benefits as a share of total employee compensation for a comparison group of employers in the system's country, as stated by the source.
